S No directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  17.10.2023 C24 No. 69 of 2023  Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Nitin Tewari, Advocate, for the applicant.

The applicant to the instant Transfer Application has sought transfer of the proceedings of Case No.
208 of 2023, Gaurav Kumar Mehta Vs. Bhawna Mehta, being the proceedings drawn under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act, from the Court of Principal Judge/Family Court, Dehradun to Principal Judge/Family Court, Ramnagar, District Nainital.

entities.text: Gaurav Kumar Mehta Vs. Bhawna Mehta
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Court of Principal Judge/Family Court, Dehradun
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The transfer has been sought on the ground, that there are several other proceedings which have been drawn by the present applicant.

For example, under Section 125 of CrPC, being Miscellaneous Criminal Case No. 166 of 2021, as well as that of the proceedings under Section 498A of IPC and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act and Section 504 and 506 of IPC, which is pending consideration before the competent Court at Ramnagar, District Nainital, where the respondent is already participating in the proceedings.

She submits that owing to the distance constraints, it is difficult for her to travel a distance of 500 km from Ramnagar to Dehradun and back to Ramnagar to participate in those proceedings under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act.

Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the proceedings under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act has been drawn by the respondent, much after the earlier proceedings drawn by her at the competent Court, Ramnagar, District Nainital.
Steps to serve the respondent would be taken by the applicant within a period of one week from today.

Till next date of listing, in case, if the applicant files an application for adjournment, though her counsel, before the Court of Principal Judge, Dehradun, the same would be permitted to be adjourned till the next date fixed in the instant Transfer Application.
